source: DERIVED, not drawn: scripts-side coverage-frame search over Siril `stat` on an 80x50 grid of 91x91 px boxes (datasets/aug06/l1_work/coverage_frame_union.json) — the largest axis-aligned rectangle every one of whose boxes clears the sibling-class sky floor on the reference channel
why: the pinned crop-to-verified-coverage that must precede any on-stack background step: `subsky`'s sample grid ingests a max-canvas's zero-coverage rims and its -tolerance excludes only BRIGHT outliers, not empty sky (docs/dead-ends.md). Crop-before-background is the pinned order.
floor_derivation: level-corrected SIBLING-CLASS SKY FLOOR. The three min-framed per-set siblings are fully covered by construction and read Siril Green Min/Median 60.4/71.8, 72.4/83.8, 67.7/79.3 -> ratios 0.841/0.864/0.854, mean 0.8530; the union's own Green median is 94.8, so the floor is 0.8530 x 94.8 = 80.9 ADU. It is corroborated by the data's own gap: of 3766 boxes carrying a Green stat, 260 read Min 0.0 and only 31 fall in (0, 80), against a clean population starting at 82.3 (p10).

last_verification_failure.method: product stack sky floor: require stat Min >= 80.9 ADU (sibling-class floor rule — never mere non-zero)
